steps.name: Install Swift toolchain and minimal native deps
steps.description: Install a pinned Swift Linux toolchain to /opt/swift if missing. The script checks for an existing matching swift version, detects the exact tarball at download.swift.org, downloads the tarball and upstream SHA256SUMS, writes a temporary checksum file in the exact 'sha256  filename' format for sha256sum -c, extracts atomically to /opt/swift, and persists PATH/CI environment via /etc/profile.d/swift.sh. Only minimal apt packages required for running the toolchain are installed; optional heavier build deps are documented but not forced. Operates in workspace: /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/simple-calculator-app-323487-323496/calculator_frontend
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/simple-calculator-app-323487-323496/calculator_frontend"
SWIFT_VERSION="5.9.4"
BASE_DIR="https://download.swift.org"
RELEASE_INDEX="${BASE_DIR}/swift-${SWIFT_VERSION}-release/"
INSTALL_DIR="/opt/swift"
TMP=$(mktemp -d)
cd "$TMP"
# minimal runtime deps; build-essential is present in image but ensure idempotent install
sudo apt-get update -qq
sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates libatomic1 >/dev/null
# Check existing installation and parse version reliably: swift --version prints like 'Swift version 5.9.4 (...)'
if [ -x "${INSTALL_DIR}/usr/bin/swift" ]; then
  INSTALLED=$(${INSTALL_DIR}/usr/bin/swift --version 2>/dev/null || true)
  INST_VER=$(printf "%s" "$INSTALLED" | awk '/Swift version/ {print $3; exit}') || true
  if [ "$INST_VER" = "$SWIFT_VERSION" ]; then
    echo "swift ${SWIFT_VERSION} already installed in ${INSTALL_DIR}"
    rm -rf "$TMP" && exit 0
  fi
fi
# discover tarball name by probing listing (fallback to canonical name)
TARBALL_CAND="swift-${SWIFT_VERSION}-RELEASE-ubuntu24.04.tar.gz"
TARBALL_URL="${RELEASE_INDEX}${TARBALL_CAND}"
# check availability
if ! curl -sfI "$TARBALL_URL" >/dev/null; then
  echo "ERROR: swift tarball not found at ${TARBALL_URL}" >&2
  rm -rf "$TMP" && exit 2
fi
# download tarball and SHA256SUMS
curl --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 -fsS -O "$TARBALL_URL"
curl --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 -fsS -O "${RELEASE_INDEX}SHA256SUMS" || true
if [ ! -f "SHA256SUMS" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: SHA256SUMS not available at ${RELEASE_INDEX}" >&2
  rm -rf "$TMP" && exit 3
fi
# extract checksum for our tarball into temporary file with format 'checksum  filename'
CHECKSUM_FILE="${TMP}/${TARBALL_CAND}.sha256"
grep "${TARBALL_CAND}" SHA256SUMS | awk '{print $1 "  " $2}' > "$CHECKSUM_FILE" || true
if [ ! -s "$CHECKSUM_FILE" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: checksum entry for ${TARBALL_CAND} not found in SHA256SUMS" >&2
  rm -rf "$TMP" && exit 4
fi
sha256sum -c "$CHECKSUM_FILE" || { echo "ERROR: checksum mismatch for ${TARBALL_CAND}" >&2; rm -rf "$TMP"; exit 5; }
# atomic extract
EXTRACT_DIR="${TMP}/swift-extract"
mkdir -p "$EXTRACT_DIR"
tar -xzf "$TARBALL_CAND" -C "$EXTRACT_DIR" --strip-components=1
sudo rm -rf "${INSTALL_DIR}.old" || true
if [ -d "$INSTALL_DIR" ]; then sudo mv "$INSTALL_DIR" "${INSTALL_DIR}.old"; fi
sudo mv "$EXTRACT_DIR" "$INSTALL_DIR"
sudo rm -rf "${INSTALL_DIR}.old" || true
# persist environment for future shells
sudo tee /etc/profile.d/swift.sh >/dev/null <<'EOF'
# Swift toolchain
export PATH=/opt/swift/usr/bin:${PATH}
export CI=true
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
EOF
sudo chmod +x /etc/profile.d/swift.sh
# make available in current process
export PATH=/opt/swift/usr/bin:${PATH}
# validate binaries
command -v swift >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ERROR: swift not on PATH" >&2; rm -rf "$TMP"; exit 6; }
SWOUT=$(swift --version 2>/dev/null || true)
SWPARSED=$(printf "%s" "$SWOUT" | awk '/Swift version/ {print $3; exit}') || true
if [ "$SWPARSED" != "$SWIFT_VERSION" ]; then
  echo "WARNING: swift --version returned '$SWOUT' (expected ${SWIFT_VERSION})" >&2
fi
command -v swiftc >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ERROR: swiftc not found" >&2; rm -rf "$TMP"; exit 7; }
# swift package is a subcommand; ensure swift can run
swift package --help >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
rm -rf "$TMP"
echo "swift toolchain installed"

steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/simple-calculator-app-323487-323496/calculator_frontend"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
START_SCRIPT="$(pwd)/start_demo.sh"
[ -x "$START_SCRIPT" ] || { echo "ERROR: start_demo.sh missing or not executable" >&2; exit 2; }
# start
"$START_SCRIPT"
# read pid file
PIDFILE="$(dirname "$START_SCRIPT")/demo.pid"
sleep 1
if [ ! -f "$PIDFILE" ]; then echo "ERROR: pidfile not created" >&2; exit 3; fi
PID=$(cat "$PIDFILE")
if kill -0 "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "demo started pid=$PID"
else
  echo "ERROR: demo not running; output may contain error" >&2
  exit 4
fi
# stop
kill "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
wait "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f "$PIDFILE" || true
echo "demo stopped"
